text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While heading out to a nearby town
with Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, aren't you getting a little peckish?
Better get some food in you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, the same thing happened
before. You know, back when we ate inari sushi."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How about we buy some good food again, pick out a spot with a nice view, and spend some classy time together?
choice_data_list: Sure, but do you know this area well?
Sure, but do you know this area well?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Nah, haven't got a clue. But there's nothin' to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Well, just follow me.
I guarantee you'll get your hands on some good food."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking around town looking for a shop,
Inari One stopped in front of an old-fashioned dango shop.
choice_data_list: You want to do it here?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well. There's only old shops around here, but
this place is swept clean right up to the eaves.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Besides, I like how they put 'Mitarashi Dango' in huge letters on the sign. It proves they take pride in what they make!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her expert eye...
Trusting Inari One's stamp of approval,
I bought the dango. And then—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, ain't that a great view!
Scenery from an unfamiliar town has its own charm, too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well then, guess I'll lay out the dango around here.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter, kid?
Don't go blubbering on me.

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
I was exploring,
and now I can't find my way home...
I just moved here, so...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Come on, pull yourself together.
Sitting around whimpering is only gonna drag your mood down further.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's this, ya hungry on top of it all?
I see, I see. No wonder you're feelin' down in the dumps, then!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—There, there. I've got some tasty dango right here.
Eat this up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "How's that? Now that your belly's full, you got a bit of energy back, yeah?"

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Thanks, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you stopped crying. Good job!
Now it's time to get you home.
Do you know your address, kiddo?

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I have the note I wrote.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Your folks sure are thoughtful!
In that case, Inari-sama will just have to whisk it all right to ya on these trusty legs!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer.
I'm gonna return this little one to its parents,
so wait up a bit for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Saying that, Inari One gave the young boy a piggyback ride and dashed off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One gives out dango and sees them safely home.
Thinking it would be wrong to just wait around for her—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, sorry to keep you waiting!
I saw them off safe and sound!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're you talkin' about?
Cut it out, there ain't nothin' to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just seeing that kid's smile
is enough to fill my belly—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Oh boy. Not looking so sharp.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Hm!? Aren't these
dango from that shop!?
Don't tell me you went and bought them again?
choice_data_list: I didn't want to just sit around waiting, so...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That said, it's quite a hike from here to the dango shop, ain't it?
You make it sound so easy, but really...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Forcing a cool face like that.
You're getting pretty stylish yourself, aren't you?
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to you, Sis!
Let's enjoy an elegant moment together.
Get outta here, that's a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Get outta here! Knock it off, that tickles!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Well, but you see.
I can tell real well that you've turned into
one fine partner, you know.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Good grief!
Before I knew it, you've grown a back one can really rely on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Inari One playfully
thumped me on the back over and over.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, true. Heh, I did promise to treat ya to some good food.
Thanks to you, I almost broke it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
With the boy's smile and the Trainer's
warmhearted touch, these are bound to turn out
as the finest dango around!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, eating dango with Inari One,
we made a charming, stylish memory.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, quite spirited, aren't ya!
Impressive, but now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Inari One suddenly started poking at my calves!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, look at ya shiverin' like jelly.
Take that, and that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Well, anyway. You look beat,
so how about we take a breather with some sweets?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Good work today. That goes for both of us!
